allowedProductImports.reason: App bootstrap may initialize Android shell shortcuts.
Android exit hook stays as a thin base consumer of AndroidShellService.
System helpers may delegate Android task-back behavior into AndroidShellService.
AppController is the thin base orchestrator between global state and product compile/runtime/service contracts.
Main stays a single bootstrap handoff into AppBootstrap.
AndroidManager stays a thin consumer for exclude-from-recents shell sync.
AppStateManager may forward runtime mode and global-mode changes into AndroidShellService.
Config providers may refresh Android tile state after persisted profile changes.
State selectors may consume platform profile and subscription advisory display hints.
Subscription notifications may read advisory display hints, but not provider policy.
GlobalState may wire compile, security, runtime registry and engine manager callbacks without embedding product policy locally.
AboutView may trigger AppUpdateService, but not AndroidUpdateBridge directly.
AccessView may consume AccessControlService editor state without embedding Android policy.
ProfilesView may consume advisory display hints and selector state only.
SendToTvPage may validate TV sync payload compatibility through a narrow product contract instead of embedding legacy product identifiers.

allowedBaseExtensions.reason: ClashLib.startVpn gains an optional optionsJson named parameter so the product runtime can pass profile-driven access control options directly, bypassing the default UI-driven merge. When optionsJson is null the upstream behaviour is preserved.
allowedBaseExtensions.contract: Optional named parameter on startVpn; no other changes.
allowedBaseExtensions.security: Profile-driven access control is resolved by the product security policy before call. No provider header influence.
allowedBaseExtensions.rollback: Remove the parameter; callers fall back to clashLib.getAndroidVpnOptions + _mergeAccessControl.

allowedBaseExtensions.reason: handleFindProxy gains an optional forceMixedPort parameter so the product layer can force the IP check through the local mixed-port inbound on Android, where the app's own traffic is otherwise excluded from VPN and goes DIRECT. Also adds _isLoopbackHost for robust loopback detection (IPv6 ::1, 'localhost' string). When forceMixedPort is false the upstream behaviour is identical.
allowedBaseExtensions.contract: Optional named parameter on handleFindProxy; private _isLoopbackHost helper; no other changes.
allowedBaseExtensions.security: Only affects the app's own HTTP client proxy resolution; does not change VPN routing for other apps.
allowedBaseExtensions.rollback: Remove the parameter and helper; callers fall back to upstream DIRECT-on-Android behaviour.

allowedBaseExtensions.reason: App gains getInstalledPackageNames() that returns just package name strings (vs getPackages which returns full Package objects). Used by the product profile pipeline to validate split-tunneling package references without deserializing full Package metadata.
allowedBaseExtensions.contract: New method returning Future<List<String>>; no changes to existing methods.
allowedBaseExtensions.security: Read-only package name enumeration; no permission changes.
allowedBaseExtensions.rollback: Remove the method; callers use getPackages and extract names.

allowedBaseExtensions.reason: AppSettingProps gains includePrereleaseUpdates (bool, default false) and skippedAppUpdateTagName (String, default empty) fields for the product AppUpdateService to support pre-release channels and skip-version.
allowedBaseExtensions.contract: Two new fields with defaults; no changes to existing fields.
allowedBaseExtensions.security: User-controlled settings only; no provider influence.
allowedBaseExtensions.rollback: Remove the fields; AppUpdateService falls back to stable-only updates.

allowedBaseExtensions.reason: Profile update/saveFile/saveFileWithString gain an optional validateConfig callback parameter so the product layer can normalize config text before clashCore.validateConfig. Also accepts both flclashx-* and flclashm-* provider headers for backward compatibility.
allowedBaseExtensions.contract: Optional callback parameter on three methods; dual header prefix support; no other changes.
allowedBaseExtensions.security: Validation callback is provided by the product layer, not provider headers.
allowedBaseExtensions.rollback: Remove the parameter and dual-prefix support; callers use clashCore.validateConfig directly.

allowedBaseExtensions.reason: compareVersions is replaced with a semver-aware _ParsedVersion implementation that handles pre-release suffixes (e.g. 1.2.4-pre10). The upstream int.parse-based implementation crashes on pre-release versions.
allowedBaseExtensions.contract: Drop-in replacement for compareVersions; same int return contract; new private _ParsedVersion class.
allowedBaseExtensions.security: No security implications; pure version string comparison.
allowedBaseExtensions.rollback: Restore the upstream int.parse-based implementation; pre-release versions will not compare correctly.

productOwnedRoots.reason: Product compilation, security, runtime and service policy is owned by FlClashM.
productOwnedRoots.contract: Base code may reach this root only through allowedProductImports.
productOwnedRoots.security: Security policy remains client-owned and independent of provider headers.
productOwnedRoots.rollback: Remove the product root and all declared base consumers to return to pure upstream.

productOwnedRoots.contract: Contains tests only; it is not shipped in the Android application.
productOwnedRoots.security: Tests assert security and rollback behaviour.

productOwnedRoots.reason: Release, boundary and upstream-drift verification is maintained by FlClashM.
productOwnedRoots.contract: Tools are build-time only and must not affect runtime behaviour.

productOwnedRoots.rollback: Remove together with FlClashM release automation.

productOwnedRoots.reason: Localized FlClashM architecture and user documentation is product-owned.

productOwnedRoots.reason: Signed Android releases bundle the declared ByeDPI, OlcRTC and NaiveProxy executables.
productOwnedRoots.contract: Assets are ABI-scoped and resolved only through the product runtime supervisor.

allowedFileGroups.contract: These files contain repository metadata and documentation only.
